baseline.wrapperGate: packages/cli/src/options.mjs loadProject: demo-* only, complete five-service profile only, storage array only, ui.enabled/singleProjectMode/firestore-array rejected, loopback only, unknown emulators.<name> a hard error
baseline.engineGate: suite-runtime validate_config: demo-* only, minimum_functions > 0, every listener unconditional, SuiteDirectory requires ui/logging/auth/functions/pubsub, host doubles as listen and connect address, rules keyed by project, export hardcodes (default)

precedence: firebase-tools-15.22.0 emulator/controller.js, commandUtils.js, constants.js, env.js, utils.js connectableHostname, auth/server.js singleProjectMode, storage/rules/config.js
fireside safety policy where the official CLI is silent (public bind warning)

recorded.onlyDerivation: filterEmulatorTargets: a top-level section or an emulators.<name> entry configures an emulator; --only filters without dependency expansion; zero targets = 'No emulators to start'
recorded.demoStorageDefault: no storage section on a demo project => templates/emulators/default_storage.rules (open) with the 'Detected demo project ID … default (open) rules configuration' line; a real project must configure rules
recorded.demoBanner: Detected demo project ID "<id>", emulated services will use a demo configuration and attempts to access non-emulated services for this project will fail.
recorded.realProjectWarning: The following emulators are not running, calls to these services from the Functions emulator will affect production: <list> (only when functions runs and only for real ids)
recorded.hostPolicy: 0.0.0.0 and :: accepted without a warning; connectableHostname maps them to 127.0.0.1 / ::1 for the hub, the UI and every exported *_EMULATOR_HOST
recorded.uiDisabled: ui.enabled false also stops the logging emulator; the hub is unaffected
recorded.singleProjectMode: default true; the Auth emulator logs WARN 'Multiple projectIds are not recommended in single project mode…' and keeps serving; never an error
recorded.multipleDatabases: the official Firestore emulator refuses a firestore array with more than one entry ('Cloud Firestore Emulator does not support multiple databases yet.') and then loads no rules

engine.unit: suite-runtime, suite-front, cli and rules-runtime tests; a two-service --no-ui real-id 0.0.0.0 suite starts, lists only its listeners in /emulators with loopback addresses, warns once per foreign project id, writes the debug log and stops cleanly

wrapper.unit: packaging/cli.test.mjs: service derivation and --only errors, storage object form and absence, firestore arrays, ui/singleProjectMode flags, real ids with the warning, non-loopback hosts with the warning, --debug log path, exec --no-ui unless --ui

resumeState.policy: --resume-state requires firestore, auth and storage (the native state receipt covers all three); subsets run with a fresh or in-memory state

publicBind.policy: a non-loopback --host is accepted and announced with one warning line; the official CLI prints nothing

realProjectIds.policy: accepted; the worker environment already sets every emulator host and strips GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS, FIREBASE_TOKEN and CLOUDSDK_AUTH_CREDENTIAL_FILE_OVERRIDE and sets METADATA_SERVER_DETECTION=none; the launcher and the banner state that user code with explicit credentials can still reach the real project

multipleDatabases.policy: a differentiator, not parity: every named database is served with its own rules (database-specific, then the project-wide hot-reload ruleset, then the default) and exported; the official emulator refuses the configuration
